name: Isometric Word-Avoidance Definition
statement: For a finite isometric set $S$ of binary words and a length $k$, take the induced subgraph $Q_k^{\mathrm{av}}(S)$ on the length-$k$ strings containing no member of $S$ as a consecutive factor.
hypotheses: The forbidden set is isometric: every pair of equal-length $S$-free strings has a Hamming geodesic consisting entirely of $S$-free strings.
